title: Document requirements for advertiser verification - Brunei - Advertising Policies Help

facts.fact: Organizations in Brunei may be required to provide two types of documentation for advertiser verification: organization registration documents and a government-issued photo ID from an authorized representative.
facts.quote: Organizations may be required to provide 2 different types of documentation for advertiser verification: organization registration documents and a government-issued photo ID from an authorized representative.

facts.fact: Individuals in Brunei must submit a Bruneian government-issued photo ID issued as part of the verification program.
facts.quote: Individuals must submit a Bruneian government-issued photo ID issued as part of the verification program.

facts.fact: Individuals may also be required to submit a second proof-of-address document that matches the full name and address already submitted.
facts.quote: In certain cases, individuals may also be required to submit a second proof-of-address document matching the full name and address already submitted.

facts.fact: A utility or phone or internet bill used as proof of address must be dated within the last 60 days.
facts.quote: A utility (for example, electricity, gas, water bill) or phone or internet bill (with a date in the last 60 days)

facts.fact: A bank statement used as proof of address must be dated within the last 60 days.
facts.quote: A bank statement (with a date in the last 60 days)

facts.fact: Acceptable proof-of-address documents include a lease or mortgage agreement, in addition to utility, phone, internet, and bank statements.
Accepted registration documents for organizations include a certificate of incorporation or registration, extract from commercial register, business license, and tax certificate.
Only government departments and agencies may submit an official letter including full name, address and date as a registration document.
facts.quote: Only for government departments and agencies: an official letter including full name, address and date

facts.fact: An authorized representative is an admin of the Google Ads account and/or the payments profile paying for the ads.
facts.quote: An authorized representative is an admin of the Google Ads account and/or the payments profile paying for the ads.

facts.fact: The government-issued photo ID of an authorized representative can be issued in any country.
facts.quote: The government-issued photo ID can be issued in any country.

facts.fact: Submitted government-issued photo IDs must be valid and not expired.
When requested, the front and back of a photo ID must be submitted separately to avoid verification failure.
facts.quote: Submit the front and back of the ID separately when requested to prevent failing the verification.

facts.fact: Submitted document details must exactly match the payments profile info, including the organization name if applicable.
facts.quote: Make sure that the details in the submitted documents exactly match your payments profile info, including the organization name, if applicable.

facts.fact: Documents must be submitted only through the Ads UI and not by email.
facts.quote: Only submit the requested documents through the Ads UI, don't send them over email.

facts.fact: Google states that personal data and documents submitted for verification will not be shared with any third party.
facts.quote: Personal data and documents won't be shared with any third party

facts.fact: The address from proof-of-address documents does not appear in ad disclosures.
facts.quote: The address won’t show in ad disclosure.
